results.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Set For Tamil, Telugu Release
results.description: Nivin Pauly and Mamitha Baiju-starrer Bethlehem Kudumba Unit will release in Tamil and Telugu on September 4, the makers announced on Monday. The post Bethlehem Kudumba Unit Set For Tamil, Telugu Release appeared first on News Today | First with the news .
